_comment: Hero photo for each page. Edited by the committee via the CMS at /admin → Site settings → Page hero photos. Leave 'image' empty to use the plain text-only hero (no backdrop). Paths should start with /assets/uploads/ (no 'public/' prefix - that's the disk path, not the URL).
